description: Implementation of an epoll-based IO broker handling registration, deregistration, and event processing for file descriptors, including thread management and event queue handling.

classes.name: io_broker_epoll
classes.description: A class managing epoll-based event handling for file descriptors, supporting registration, deregistration, and event processing in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: io_broker_epoll
methods.description: Constructor initializing epoll, control event fd, and starting the event handling thread.

methods.name: ~io_broker_epoll
methods.description: Destructor that stops the thread, deregisters fds, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: rearm_fd
methods.description: Rearms a file descriptor in epoll interest list.

methods.name: thread_loop
methods.description: Main loop processing epoll events and handling registration/deregistration.

methods.name: enqueue_event
methods.description: Adds control events to the internal queue and triggers epoll to wake up.

methods.name: handle_enqueued_events
methods.description: Processes queued control events such as register/deregister fd and shutdown.

methods.name: handle_fd_registration
methods.description: Registers a new file descriptor with epoll and associates callbacks.

methods.name: handle_fd_epoll_removal
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor from epoll interest list, optionally reporting errors.

methods.name: register_fd
methods.description: Public method to register a file descriptor with callbacks, thread-safe.

methods.name: unregister_fd
methods.description: Public method to deregister a file descriptor, thread-safe.

methods.name: stop_impl
methods.description: Stops the event loop, deregisters all fds, and cleans up.
